title: Sensor count message
description: Published every 5 s on venue/{venue_id}/sensor/{sensor_id}/count. Counts only: no positions or identities.

ts.description: Simulation time in seconds since run start

sent_at.description: Wall-clock time the message was sent (Unix s), for latency only

sensor_id.description: Mounting spot id from the venue file (sensor_candidates)

zone_id.description: Zone the sensor covers (from the venue file)

count.description: Noisy number of detected devices or tags

seq.description: Report number since the event started (same for all sensors); gaps = lost messages

sketch.description: Option B: the sensor's 16 x 128-bit linear-counting sketch of salted device hashes, bit-packed and base64 encoded. No IDs.
